rafter--noun.def: One of the sloping beams that support a roof.
rafter--noun.ex: A bird nested in the rafters.
rafter--noun.exTr: Bir kuş çatı kirişlerine yuva yaptı.

real-estate--noun.def: Land and buildings considered as property.

recommendable--adj.def: Good enough to be suggested to others.

referent--adj.def: Pointing to the thing a word stands for.
referent--adj.ex: The pronoun has a clear referent function.
referent--adj.exTr: Zamirin açık bir gönderge işlevi var.

reprint--noun.def: A new printing of a book without changes.

reprove--verb.def: To tell someone that you disapprove of what they did.
reprove--verb.exTr: Öğretmen onu yumuşak bir dille azarladı.

respectably--adv.def: In a way that deserves respect, or well enough.
respectably--adv.exTr: Takım fena sayılmayacak bir yerde bitirdi.

ruinous--adj.def: Causing great damage or great cost.
ruinous--adj.ex: The fine was ruinous for the shop.

rush-hour--noun.def: The time of day when traffic is heaviest.
rush-hour--noun.ex: Avoid the rush hour if you can.

salesmanship--noun.def: The skill of persuading people to buy.

scholasticism--noun.def: The strict style of medieval religious philosophy.

second-person--noun.def: The form of a verb used with the word you.
second-person--noun.ex: The poem uses the second person.

semicolon--noun.def: The mark used to join two related sentences.
semicolon--noun.ex: Replace the comma with a semicolon.

simplification--noun.def: The act of making something easier to understand.

skateboarder--noun.def: A person who rides a skateboard.

smokestack--noun.def: A tall chimney on a factory or a ship.
smokestack--noun.ex: The smokestack is no longer used.

solidity--noun.def: The quality of being firm and strong.
solidity--noun.ex: The solidity of the wall reassured us.

soliloquy--noun.def: A speech an actor makes alone on stage.
soliloquy--noun.ex: The soliloquy opens the third act.

sparerib--noun.def: A pork rib with most of the meat cut away.

speeder--noun.def: A driver who goes faster than the limit.
speeder--noun.exTr: Polis hız yapan iki sürücüyü durdurdu.

spokeswoman--noun.def: A woman chosen to speak for a group.

stanza--noun.def: A group of lines forming one part of a poem.

steering-wheel--noun.def: The wheel a driver turns to steer a car.
steering-wheel--noun.ex: Keep both hands on the steering wheel.

stock-market--noun.def: The place where company shares are bought and sold.

stonework--noun.def: The stone parts of a building.

subcontinent--noun.def: A large part of a continent, such as India.

subculture--noun.def: A group within a society with its own style and values.
subculture--noun.ex: The film studies a youth subculture.
subculture--noun.exTr: Film bir gençlik alt kültürünü inceliyor.

subjunctive--noun.def: The verb form used for wishes and doubts.

subplot--noun.def: A second less important story inside a book or a film.

synonym--noun.def: A word that means almost the same as another.
synonym--noun.exTr: Big için bir eş anlamlı bul.

tatter--noun.def: A torn piece of cloth hanging loose.

thickly--adv.def: In a thick layer, or densely.

third-person--noun.def: The form of a verb used with he, she or they.
third-person--noun.ex: The novel is written in the third person.

timeliness--noun.def: The quality of happening at the right moment.
timeliness--noun.ex: The timeliness of the warning saved lives.

tortoiseshell--noun.def: The hard patterned shell of a turtle, used for objects.
tortoiseshell--noun.ex: The comb is made of tortoiseshell.

transitive--adj.def: Said of a verb that takes an object.

truthfulness--noun.def: The quality of telling the truth.

unashamedly--adv.def: Without feeling any shame about something.

uncharacteristic--adj.def: Not typical of a person's usual behaviour.

unclearly--adv.def: In a way that is hard to understand.

undreamed--adj.exTr: Hayal bile edilmemiş bir zenginlik getirdi.

uneasily--adv.def: In a worried and uncomfortable way.
uneasily--adv.ex: He shifted uneasily in his seat.

unmistakably--adv.def: So clearly that there can be no doubt.

unthinkably--adv.def: To a degree that is impossible to accept or imagine.
unthinkably--adv.exTr: Görev akıl almaz derecede zor görünüyordu.

untrimmed--adj.def: Not cut neatly or not decorated at the edges.
untrimmed--adj.ex: The untrimmed hedge blocked the path.

unusualness--noun.def: The quality of being different from the normal.
unusualness--noun.ex: The unusualness of the case drew attention.

unworldly--adj.def: Not experienced in practical everyday life.
unworldly--adj.ex: He is gentle and rather unworldly.
unworldly--adj.exTr: Nazik ve dünya işlerinden biraz uzak biri.

upside-down--adj.def: With the top part at the bottom.
upside-down--adj.ex: The upside down map confused us.

upside-down--adv.def: In a position with the top at the bottom.
upside-down--adv.ex: He hung the picture upside down.

virtual-reality--noun.def: A computer world that feels almost real.
virtual-reality--noun.ex: The museum offers virtual reality tours.

wallboard--noun.def: Flat board used to cover an inside wall.
wallboard--noun.ex: They fixed wallboard over the bricks.

well-organized--adj.ex: It was a well organized event.

woodcarving--noun.def: The art of cutting shapes into wood.
woodcarving--noun.exTr: Kapı güzel bir ahşap oymacılığı gösteriyor.

wordlessly--adv.ex: She wordlessly handed him the key.
wordlessly--adv.exTr: Tek kelime etmeden ona anahtarı verdi.

workbench--noun.def: A strong table used for making and repairing things.
workbench--noun.ex: The tools lie on the workbench.

worktable--noun.def: A table used for doing work such as sewing.

wornout--adj.def: Too old or too tired to be used any more.
